metadata.title: Platform Time Synchronization and Sources

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for acquiring and synchronizing time from authoritative sources in a controlled and accountable manner.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Time synchronization mechanisms, authoritative clock sources, and upstream time dependencies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern governing how time is sourced and synchronized without embedding time semantics or enforcement policy.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Time synchronization and source selection inherit baseline trust assumptions defined in Platform Time Core.

metadata.remarks: Platform Time Synchronization and Sources defines how time is acquired and synchronized across the platform. It governs authoritative sources, synchronization behavior, and dependency control to ensure platform time remains correct and defensible.

components.title: Authoritative Time Sources
components.description: Defines which time sources are considered authoritative for the platform.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise or manipulation of upstream dependencies used as authoritative time sources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled selection and validation of trusted upstream dependencies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authoritative time sources are explicitly defined and governed.

components.title: Time Synchronization Mechanisms
components.description: Controls how platform systems synchronize time with authoritative sources.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Integrity degradation through manipulation of time synchronization behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle control of synchronized state to preserve system integrity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time synchronization mechanisms are configured explicitly and restricted to approved behavior.

components.title: Time Dependency Control
components.description: Governs upstream dependencies and trust relationships used for time synchronization.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Discovery or exploitation of implicit time dependencies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit dependency definition and boundary enforcement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Time synchronization dependencies are explicitly defined and governed.
